desc: Two Spanish nuns in 1990s habits: the older one, glasses, hand on her chest, scandalised; the younger trying not to smile. Standing, three-quarter view, watching (Canva).

A German family from Düsseldorf off the plane with a luggage trolley: father (moustache, socks and sandals, camcorder bag), mother (perm, pastel windbreaker), a boy in a Germany shirt, a girl pointing. Standing, staring (Higgsfield).
